Name: Rhythm Fishing
Author: LenCN
Description:
[size=5][b]Rhythm Fishing[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]🎣 Introduction[/b][/size]
Tired of the vanilla "keep the bar on the fish" mechanic? [b]Rhythm Fishing[/b] completely overhauls the fishing minigame, turning it into a test of reflexes and rhythm!
Instead of chasing the fish, you must hit the [b]Action Button[/b] exactly when the moving cursor overlaps with the target zone. Chain your hits, build up your score, and catch them all!
[size=4][b]✨ Key Features[/b][/size]
[b]🎵 Rhythm Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Wait for the orange cursor to align with the blue target zone.
[*]Click to hit! Chain successful hits to catch the fish.
[*][b]Perfect / Good / Miss[/b] judgments based on your accuracy.
[/list]
[b]📈 Dynamic Difficulty[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Easy Fish:[/b] Slow, linear movement.
[*][b]Hard Fish:[/b] Faster speeds and complex patterns (Sine waves, Stop & Go, Chaos).
[*][b]Legendary Fish:[/b] Are you ready for the chaos?
[/list]
[b]🧰 Tackle Support[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Cork Bobber:[/b] Widens the target hit zone.
[*][b]Trap Bobber:[/b] Increases the max time limit.
[*][b]Treasure Hunter:[/b] Speeds up treasure chest unlocking progress.
[*][b]Barbed Hook:[/b] Slows down the cursor for better control.
[*][i]Note: Standard tackle effects that occur [b]before[/b] the minigame starts, such as the Treasure Hunter increasing chest spawn rate or the Dressed Spinner reducing bite time, still work as normal![/i]
[*][color=red]Note: Lead Bobber and Sonar Bobber are not supported in the minigame[/color]
[/list]
[b]⚙️ Highly Configurable[/b]
[list]
[*]Supports [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b].
[*]Adjust difficulty, speed, hit counts, and tackle effectiveness values.
[*]Choose between "Dynamic" (based on fish difficulty) or "Custom" modes.
[/list]
[size=4][b]🎮 Controls[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Mouse:[/b] Left Click
[*][b]Keyboard:[/b] 'C' key (or your tool use key)
[*][b]Gamepad:[/b] 'X' or 'A' button
[/list]
[size=4][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*](Recommended) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game configuration.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[*]Run the game!
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=red]🤖 AI Disclosure[/color][/b][/size]
[color=red]This mod's code was generated with the assistance of Artificial Intelligence (Large Language Models).[/color]

[size=5][b]中文介绍 (Chinese Description)[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]🎣 介绍[/b][/size]
厌倦了原版“把绿条保持在鱼身上”的机制了吗？[b]Rhythm Fishing (节奏钓鱼)[/b] 彻底重构了钓鱼小游戏，将其变成了一场反应力与节奏感的考验！
你不再需要追着鱼跑，而是需要在光标与目标区域重合的瞬间按下[b]动作键[/b]。保持连击，累积高分，把它们统统钓上来！
[size=4][b]✨ 核心特性[/b][/size]
[b]🎵 节奏玩法[/b]
[list]
[*]等待橙色光标与蓝色目标区域重合，点击命中！
[*]连续命中即可成功钓起。
[*]根据精准度会有 [b]Perfect / Good / Miss[/b] 的判定。
[/list]
[b]📈 动态难度[/b]
[list]
[*][b]简单鱼类：[/b] 缓慢的线性移动。
[*][b]困难鱼类：[/b] 更快的速度和复杂的轨迹（正弦波、急停、混沌移动）。
[*][b]传说鱼类：[/b] 你准备好迎接挑战了吗？
[/list]
[b]🧰 钓具支持[/b]
[list]
[*][b]软木塞浮标 (Cork Bobber):[/b] 增加判定区宽度，更容易命中。
[*][b]陷阱浮标 (Trap Bobber):[/b] 增加最大倒计时时间，容错率更高。
[*][b]寻宝者 (Treasure Hunter):[/b] 加快宝箱捕获进度。
[*][b]倒刺钩 (Barbed Hook):[/b] 降低光标移动速度，提高稳定性。
[*][i]注：原版钓具在小游戏开始前的效果依然生效！例如寻宝者依然会增加宝箱出现的概率，精装旋式鱼饵依然会减少咬钩时间。[/i]
[*][color=red]注：本模式下不支持铅制浮标和声纳浮标[/color]
[/list]
[b]⚙️ 高度自定义[/b]
[list]
[*]支持 [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] 配置菜单。
[*]你可以调整难度、速度、命中次数以及钓具的具体数值效果。
[*]支持“动态难度”（推荐）或“自定义难度”模式。
[/list]
[size=4][b]🎮 操作方法[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]鼠标：[/b] 左键
[*][b]键盘：[/b] C键 (或你的工具使用键)
[*][b]手柄：[/b] X 或 A 键
[/list]
[size=4][b]📥 安装方法[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]安装 [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]。
[*](推荐) 安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 以便在游戏中调整配置。
[*]下载本模组并解压到你的 [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] 文件夹中。
[*]启动游戏！
[/list]
